purpose: Experiment E-SPN-0057 in the spin arena: the bulk is the husk's heat bath, fail as gated: with the depth step broken by the {3,4,3,4} cusp's measure as each layer's collision clock (a stand-in for the warped metric), the depth-uniform fill that the flat box keeps at 9 times the Fermi-Dirac Fano factor leaves the husk sector at once and its depth-moving slots relax to independent exclusive slots in about 40 performed collision beats, but at the full warp the deep layers' clocks (lambda^-j per beat) are so slow that their in-layer slots stay at the start for 1,500 beats (diagonal class 2.98 times Fermi-Dirac).
